integrity: Proof uses a complete finite chain model, exact differential rank lower bound and an independently checked unimodular integral cycle minor. No external mathematical review performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the third integral homology of unordered three-point configurations on GP(12,5), and the subgroup generated by disjoint embedded-cycle product three-tori, is determined. Lower homology, ring structure and other graphs are outside scope. Unindexed equivalent work is possible.
title: One non-product top-homology generator for three particles on the Nauru graph
